name: text
description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text to use within the label. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

name: html
description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML to use within the label. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

name: caller
description: Not strictly an option but supports the [`call` block](https://mozilla.github.io/nunjucks/templating.html#call) as an alternative to the `html` option. To use it, you will need to wrap the entire label component in a `call` block.

name: visuallyHiddenText
description: A visually hidden suffix added to the label.

name: for
description: The label `for` attribute, the ID of the input the label is associated with.

name: heading
description: Whether the label also acts as a heading.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the label heading.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text to use within the label as a heading. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML to use within the label as a heading. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: visuallyHiddenText
params.description: A visually hidden suffix added to the label as a heading.

params.name: caption
params.description: Optional caption for the label as a heading.

params.name: size
params.description: Size of the label as a heading – `"s"`, `"m"`, `"l"` or `"xl"`.

params.name: level
params.description: Optional label heading level. Defaults to `1`.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the label heading.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the label tag.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the label tag.
